title: Import first-pass platform checks and current admin-address guidance
steps: Run the command in run.cmd from this checkout with dependencies installed. The browser renders the actual ImportWizard and controls read-only preflight responses.
Keep the site field focused while detection is delayed; edit site/platform during an earlier request; enter an unreachable admin URL on another host and path.
expect: Continue is disabled before and during current preflight; the first mismatch stays on step 1 with Switch to WordPress primary and Continue with Joomla.
Changing address or platform invalidates prior results and stale replies cannot release Continue.
Admin guidance label and href exactly match the entered address, including custom host, path, query, and fragment; external target and rel stay safe.
evidence: Develop acceptance of PR #1555: case 2 bypassed the first mismatch; case 20 displayed wordpress.org/administrator while linking to the newly typed unreachable admin URL. Both new browser assertions fail on origin/develop 1b339a7556 before source changes.
fence: Real ImportWizard, preflight state, and rich-text renderer in Chromium; read-only detection and ownership doors are controlled for deterministic timing. Does not start an import or exercise CMS credentials.

tests: the first delayed platform result keeps Continue disabled until the mismatch choice is shown
changing the address or platform immediately invalidates the earlier preflight result
unreachable admin guidance displays and links the exact address currently entered
